correctness.rationale: The first-block size is derived from parity-refined generating functions and the boundary mean from the published exploration. The branching renewal equation gives exact susceptibility. The derivative proof establishes \(V'(p_c)>0\) using \(f'<0\), \(v'\le0\) and \(p(1-p)^3v^2<1\) on the full critical interval, with no second-moment assumption. Positive numerator follows from the root-edge-open event. 247 finite checker assertions corroborate but do not replace the proof.

value.rationale: Susceptibility amplitude is a natural quantitative response invariant beyond the percolation threshold; the exact, positive simple-pole constant across arbitrary finite-mean and infinite-variance offspring laws identifies a structural mean-field boundary despite cyclic grandparent shortcuts. This permits comparisons of families that share a mean but have different pgfs and is not just a recomputation of the already-known regular-tree critical parameter.
